title: What are the guidelines regarding decorum, guest boundaries, and maintaining the sacred environment of Ashaeiynn?

segments.text: Upholding Sanctity & Respect ​Sacred Atmosphere: Ashaeiynn is a sacred space dedicated to spiritual growth, devotion, and peace. All guests and devotees are expected to conduct themselves with high decorum, humility, and reverence for the ashram grounds and traditions. ​Respecting Boundaries: Mind personal boundaries at all times. Treat fellow visitors, members, and Ashaeiynn staff with mutual respect, courtesy, and consideration. Divine Oversight & Zero-Tolerance Policy ​Constant Observation: Beyond physical presence, millions of saints and divine energies reside at the venue during the Mahotsav. Gurudev Himself is keenly observing everyone throughout the event. ​Spiritual Consequences: You are not merely under human supervision—Gurudev and the divine presence judge all actions directly. Any misconduct, breach of boundaries, or violation of guidelines will invite direct spiritual action from Gurudev long before any human intervention takes place. ​Zero-Tolerance for Misbehavior: There is a strict zero-tolerance policy for any conduct that disturbs the peace or sanctity of Ashaeiynn. Make every effort to carry yourself with the utmost respect, awareness, and purity of intent.
